description.value:
Of all the things that are symbolic of the nation of Ishgard, few are more recognized than the dragoon. Born amidst the timeless conflict between men and dragons, these lance-wielding knights have developed an aerial style of combat, that they might better pierce the scaled hides of their mortal foes. Taking to the firmament as though it were an extension of the land, they descend upon the enemy with every ounce of their bodies behind the blow.

It is this penetrative power that characterizes the dragoon. The dragoon class epitomizes aerial combat, centered around their iconic "Jump" ability. More than just a leap, it's a devastating strike that allows them to spring high above the fray, becoming a fleeting blur before descending with incredible force upon their foes.

This signature move often grants temporary invulnerability or evasion while airborne, culminating in a powerful, often piercing or bludgeoning, attack against a single foe. Proficient with polearms like spears and lances, dragoons leverage their reach and the momentum of their descent, typically favoring heavy armor for its robust protection while paradoxically maintaining surprising agility for their airborne assaults. Beyond their aerial prowess. Serving as versatile skirmishers and burst damage dealers, the dragoon is a testament to the blend of martial discipline and the raw power of the skies, consistently evolving their airborne techniques as they gain experience.

Role

The dragoon stands out as a master of aerial combat and polearm mastery, with their signature "Jump" ability defining their unique role on the battlefield. Primarily a high-burst damage dealer, dragoons excel at temporarily vanishing from the ground to descend with devastating force upon a chosen foe, often bypassing front-line defenses or striking vulnerable targets from an unexpected angle.

Beyond raw damage, their ability to control vertical space makes them invaluable for engaging flying enemies, repositioning across hazardous terrain, or even evading dangerous area-of-effect attacks. Wielding powerful lances and spears, they combine incredible mobility with piercing attacks, making them disruptive, hard-hitting strikers capable of breaking enemy formations and delivering critical blows to priority targets.

Class Skills

The dragoon's class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Handle Animal (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana) (Int), Knowledge (local) (Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

A dragoon is proficient with all simple weapons and all weapons from the polearm and spear weapon groups, as well as light, medium, and heavy armor, but not with shields.

Main Ability Score

The dragoon mainly focuses on Strength for martial combat and Dexterity for their aerial maneuvers and jump-based abilities.
